waitZeroDepositContext.interpretation: With no pre-entry deposit months, the base-savings wait-zero R90 gate is a policy-feasibility hurdle that even the true-parameter control fails. It is not independent evidence of covariance-model misspecification. The frozen gate is retained without changing its outcome.

limitations: Available-case forecasts are conditional on numerical qualification; unconditional availability and failed slots remain explicit.
Paired normal intervals describe Monte Carlo uncertainty; 64 main worlds and 16 inner refits are a bounded qualification experiment.
Finite multistart, projected-gradient and directional probes do not certify a global optimum.
Synthetic evaluation is not a historical-availability backtest or a promise of financial improvement.
The frozen financial laboratory holds CPI and investment returns at zero to isolate cost forecast consequences; it does not calibrate the full joint economic model.
